reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: updateNickname is registered as a live route handler at src/index.ts:74 — non-test caller confirmed. Gate 2: entry point is POST /api/nickname/update (external HTTP, not covered by any trusted data source). Gate 3: src/api/ is explicitly in scope; 'Nickname update without input sanitization' is listed as a key security concern in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json. An attacker with a valid Bearer token can trigger this via POST /api/nickname/update by supplying an arbitrarily long or Unicode-crafted name value, causing the assembled updatedNickname (L87/L90) to exceed Discord's 32-char limit and produce a predictable 500 error, or injecting visual-spoofing characters (zero-width joiners, RTL overrides) directly into the member's Discord display name. Severity MEDIUM retained: impact is scoped to Discord display name manipulation and service disruption for nickname updates; requires valid Bearer token.
reviewed_items.spec_reference: SG-007_updateNickname — assertion: forall req: updateNickname(uid, name) => len(name) <= 32 && sanitized(name)
